## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 430 captures during November 2024. This provides the activity level for the month and indicates the volume of images submitted for review. The recorded captures form the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 430 captures, 27 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for November 2024.

## Grading

There were 127 referable results during the month. The median grading lag was 6 days. This is the midpoint of the recorded waiting time for grading and provides an overall indication of service timeliness.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Overall, the report records activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for Harbour Eye Clinic in November 2024.
